en.title: zg (zvec-grep) - Local Search Infrastructure Beyond Keyword Matching
en.hook: A CLI search infrastructure enabling embedding-based semantic vector search across local files and codebases beyond simple keyword matching.
key_takeaways: Overcomes limitations of traditional grep by providing context-aware search using vector embeddings
Builds efficient vector indexing infrastructure tailored for local execution
Ideal for searching codebases and performing semantic queries over large local text files

zh.title: zg(zvec-grep) - 超越关键词匹配的本地搜索基础设施

适用于代码库探索与针对海量本地文本的语义查询
